mapper.sql: id, username, password, real_name, id_card, phone, email, avatar, role, department, branch_code, branch_name, work_area, work_longitude, work_latitude, work_radius, employee_no, qualification_no, status, deleted, last_login_time, last_login_ip, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE phone = #{phone} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE role = #{role, typeHandler=com.insurance.claim.enums.handler.RoleTypeHandler} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT , (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{latitude})) * cos(radians(work_latitude)) * cos(radians(work_longitude) - radians(#{longitude})) + sin(radians(#{latitude})) * sin(radians(work_latitude)))) AS distance FROM sys_user WHERE role = 3 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 HAVING distance <= work_radius OR distance <= #{radius} ORDER BY distance ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime}, last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( username, password, real_name, id_card, phone, email, avatar, role, department, branch_code, branch_name, work_area, work_longitude, work_latitude, work_radius, employee_no, qualification_no, status, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{role, typeHandler=com.insurance.claim.enums.handler.RoleTypeHandler}, #{department}, #{branchCode}, #{branchName}, #{workArea}, #{workLongitude}, #{workLatitude}, #{workRadius}, #{employeeNo}, #{qualificationNo}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
